context: A wordy draft PR body is cut to slopcourier's limits without losing a fact: outcome sentence, one visual aid for the staging numbers, a few one-line bullets, no filler or AI tells, no file list or test counts, and nothing opened on GitHub.

checklist.name: Within word limits
checklist.description: Counting the final body.md: at most 75 words outside tables, code blocks, and collapsed details, at most 150 words in total including tables, and at most 5 top-level bullets. Over any limit scores 0.

checklist.name: Bug and cause kept
checklist.description: The body says exports over 10,000 rows stopped at 10,000, and that the exporter ignored the API's next_cursor after the first page and now follows it until it is empty.

checklist.name: Staging numbers kept
checklist.description: The body keeps the staging measurements: 48,213 rows returned (was 10,000), 41 s (was 9 s), and peak memory flat at about 120 MB.

checklist.name: Risk and links kept
checklist.description: The body keeps the risk that exports above about 70,000 rows may hit the 60-second gateway timeout, tracked in #212, and keeps `Closes #198`.

checklist.name: No AI tells or filler
checklist.description: The body has none of the draft's filler: no 'comprehensive', 'robust', 'seamlessly', 'it's worth noting', 'thorough investigation', 'In summary', or triplet lists such as 'data integrity, user trust, and downstream reporting'; no Summary, Testing, or Conclusion scaffold headings.

checklist.name: No inventory or test counts
checklist.description: The body does not list changed files and does not mention the 6 new tests or the 312 passing tests.

checklist.name: Checked file goes up
checklist.description: delivery.md opens the PR with `--body-file body.md` (no inline `--body`), ready for review, with a conventional-commit title that leads with the user-visible outcome, and the agent pushes and opens nothing.
